title: Bhima I
hook: Bhima I: Somnath par Mahmud ka aakraman
exam_points: Mahmud Ghaznavi ne 1025-26 mein Somnath mandir loota (inke samay).
Modhera Sun Temple (c. 1026-27) inke samay ka; Mount Abu ka Dilwara (Adinath) mandir Vimala Shah ne banwaya (c. 1031).

mcqs.q: Mahmud Ghaznavi ne Somnath kab loota?
